sections.title: Type 1 Conditional (Real Possibility)
sections.content:
Structure: If + Present Simple, will + base verb
यह वास्तविक और संभव स्थिति बताता है।

3-4 चरण समाधान विधि:
Step 1: If clause पहचानें।
Step 2: देखें क्या स्थिति संभव/भविष्य से जुड़ी है।
Step 3: If clause में Present Simple रखें।
Step 4: Main clause में will + verb लगाएं।

Example:
If it rains, we will stay at home.

sections.title: Type 2 Conditional (Unreal Present)
sections.content:
Structure: If + Simple Past, would + base verb
यह वर्तमान या भविष्य की काल्पनिक स्थिति बताता है।

3-4 चरण समाधान विधि:
Step 1: देखें क्या स्थिति काल्पनिक है।
Step 2: If clause में Simple Past लगाएं।
Step 3: Main clause में would + verb लगाएं।
Step 4: Be verb के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग करें (If I were...).

Example:
If I were rich, I would travel the world.

sections.title: Type 3 Conditional (Unreal Past)
sections.content:
Structure: If + Past Perfect, would have + V3
यह भूतकाल की काल्पनिक स्थिति बताता है।

3-4 चरण समाधान विधि:
Step 1: देखें क्या बात अतीत में असंभव थी।
Step 2: If clause में had + V3 लगाएं।
Step 3: Main clause में would have + V3 लगाएं।
Step 4: दोनों clauses में past sense बनाए रखें।

Example:
If she had studied, she would have passed.

sections.title: Simple Past और Past Perfect का संयोजन
sections.content:
Past Perfect पहले हुई घटना बताता है, Simple Past बाद की।

3-4 चरण समाधान विधि:
Step 1: दो भूतकाल की घटनाएं पहचानें।
Step 2: जो पहले हुई उसे Past Perfect बनाएं।
Step 3: जो बाद में हुई उसे Simple Past रखें।
Step 4: Sequence logically जांचें।

Example:
She had finished her work before she left.

sections.title: Time Clauses (when, before, until, as soon as)
sections.content:
Time clause में future meaning हो तो भी Present tense ही आता है।

3-4 चरण समाधान विधि:
Step 1: Time word पहचानें (when, before, until, as soon as)।
Step 2: Clause future से जुड़ा हो तो भी Present Simple रखें।
Step 3: Main clause में will या अन्य future form लगाएं।
Step 4: दो future verbs साथ न रखें।

Example:
When she arrives, we will start.
As soon as he finishes, he will call me.

sections.title: Future Perfect Continuous
sections.content:
Structure: will have been + verb-ing
यह भविष्य में किसी समय तक चल रहे कार्य की अवधि बताता है।

3-4 चरण समाधान विधि:
Step 1: भविष्य का specific time देखें (by 2027, by next month)।
Step 2: अवधि हो तो for/since देखें।
Step 3: will have been + verb-ing लगाएं।
Step 4: समय की निरंतरता जांचें।

Example:
By next year, she will have been working here for five years.

sections.title: सामान्य गलतियाँ
sections.content:
1. If clause में will लगाना (गलत)।
2. Type 2 में was की जगह were न लगाना।
3. Time clause में future verb लगा देना।
4. Past Perfect और Simple Past का क्रम उल्टा करना।

sections.title: त्वरित सारांश
sections.content:
Type 1 = Real future, Type 2 = Unreal present, Type 3 = Unreal past।
पहले हुई घटना = Past Perfect।
Time clause में future meaning हो तो भी Present tense।
Future Perfect Continuous = भविष्य तक चल रही अवधि।

tricks.title: No Will in If Rule
tricks.explanation: If clause में कभी will नहीं लगाएं (सामान्य conditionals में)।
tricks.example: If he comes, I will help. (Not: If he will come)

tricks.title: Were Trick
tricks.explanation: Type 2 में I/he/she के साथ भी were का प्रयोग करें।
tricks.example: If I were you, I would try again.

tricks.title: Had + V3 पहचान
tricks.explanation: If clause में had + V3 दिखे तो Type 3 सोचें।
tricks.example: If she had called, I would have answered.

tricks.title: Earlier Event = Past Perfect
tricks.explanation: दो past actions में जो पहले हुआ उसे had + V3 बनाएं।
tricks.example: He had left before I arrived.

tricks.title: Time Clause Present Rule
tricks.explanation: When, before, until, as soon as के बाद Present tense।
tricks.example: When he finishes, we will go.

tricks.title: Future Duration पहचान
tricks.explanation: By + future time और for/since दिखे तो Future Perfect Continuous सोचें।
tricks.example: By 2026, she will have been teaching for ten years.

tricks.title: Would Have Signal
tricks.explanation: Would have + V3 दिखे तो past unreal situation है।
tricks.example: She would have won if she had tried.

tricks.title: Double Future Avoid
tricks.explanation: Time clause और main clause दोनों में future verb न रखें।
tricks.example: When he comes, we will start. (Correct)
